sections.Outcome: This is a PARTIAL Stage transitive inventory and a bounded dice/gacha application-component analysis, not H-B02 closure. It identifies actual effects through named RNG/clock/FS boundaries and expands selected health, settings, QTE-reminder, validation, snapshot and catch branches. The validator, several reminder/normalizer/aggregation helpers, baseline/restoration graph, native publication custody and browser graph remain explicitly open. A direct composite call is never certified a leaf. No engineering release or runtime qualification follows.
sections.Custody and same-action rule:
The existing entry is ProcessPlayerTurnAsync1495→participating delegate1497→Stage. The proposed retained parent/seal design must enroll the Stage child BEFORE invocation, including its synchronous prefix. Its actual main access and outer+inner admission frames remain live; nested health participation borrows the original lane and never creates a second root. The prior two-barrier design stays conditional: source/native seal and actual already-armed debt settlement under original ownership; all pending acquisitions, I/O/callbacks and release work join; only then stop metadata obtains canonical storage; final read-only disposal and natural pin release follow. No current source change in this report implements that contract.

Technical preparation is unissued relative to a GM accepted turn, but is not effect-free: health can publish, QTE summary is consumed, settings/schedule change, RNG runs, backup/original authority is created, and a provisional request is physically written. Retain the exact original action/session/G/n and every already-produced identity, timestamp, dice/control/output. No source replay, extra Mortal tick, second reward or new dice grant. Accepted source/original/committed mechanics remain accepted; a Stage or dice receipt cannot retire the parent, HC/H2/H3 or the main operation. Eventual ordinary continuation must complete the same situation through its existing owners and remaining work/budget; permanent HOLD is not the lawful outcome.
sections.Concrete proposed dice seam (UNACCEPTED):
In GameEngine.TurnLifecycle at1497, a parent-owned StagePreparationFrame registers a child before invoking Stage, retains the exact call task and later request/Explorer/backup references. At1585 split only the existing object allocation/assignments from the awaited reminder initializer so the original request reference is retained before1592. This is a proposed integration edit, not current behavior or authority.

At4534 AttachPendingDiceAndGachaAsync passes that live child to a new internal PendingTurnStateService.GetOrCreateForOriginalStageAsync(StagePreparationFrame) adapter. It uses the same existing branch predicates and the same original FS owner. A private DicePreparationFrame stores branch/read witness, original state object, visible[20], hidden[4], successful slot count, computed gacha, original time values, exact serialized bytes, pending acquisition and actual publication outcome/task references. It is a live object, not an importable DTO or reconstructed capability. A closed diagnostic record could contain operation/G/parent-child IDs, cut enum, actual path and content digest, but can authorize no work on replay.

Proposed cuts: Reading→ReuseChosen OR DrawingVisible(0..20)→DrawingHidden(0..4)→Calculated→PublicationArmed→PublicationDecided→Joined. Before each RNG Fill and publication native call, source-gate registration must win atomically against seal; retain result before completing that registration. A seal after gate win joins that exact operation; losing gate runs no effect. Pure arithmetic may finish under a registered task, without new native input. Serializing retained bytes is data processing, not authority to republish. Capture result before facade exception or lease release can obscure disposition. Do not inject typed held exceptions into pure deserialize catch or an already-armed transactional publisher: that can create the invalid-state branch or native rollback.

Partial draw interruption is NOT closed: current GenerateSecureRandomDice keeps arrays/index in an unexposed synchronous method, and no original-source resumable frame exists. The design requires an in-memory slot-preserving helper with explicit original partial-failure/continuation policy, verified independently before code. It must not reexecute successful slots, reenter Stage, or finish unarmed slots during settlement. Future authorized continuation may use remaining work only; this report grants neither extra draws nor a cold recovery route. Public GetOrCreate reads without the explicit lease overload; changing it to a new long-held lease would change locking/visibility and is not silently proposed.
sections.Typed held propagation and real errors:
Typed held is a distinct private control outcome of original custody, never null-preparation, Cancelled, EOF, validation failure, malformed JSON, lost input or generic Exception. The concrete catch hazards are Stage1629,1672,1694,1717,1731; StateManager144; snapshot creation catches; Characteristics helper catches; and optional callback/provider failures. Stage must dispatch held before ordinary cleanup/error logging, while genuine source failures continue to their actual existing handlers. A completed file publication plus failing callback is two outcomes, not a rollback certificate. Read recovery and lease release can themselves issue work: no late generic Dispose/read/Verify can reopen storage after seal.

This report does not prescribe blanket changes to every catch: pure parse catches are safe places to leave malformed-data policy when held cannot be injected there. Actual transactional catches must retain the original armed decision; root stop must not use cancellation that launches arbitrary new cleanup/storage through callback providers. Each open internal edge must prove its own exact held path before the composite is admitted.
sections.Native and external boundaries:
Application dice reads/writes reach actual FileSystemManager admission, recovery, opened streams, hooks, mutation registration and TrustedLocalFilePublication. The local publication wrapper creates directories before its own mutation registration, so parent pre-effect enrollment must precede wrapper invocation. Its committed facade permits pending cleanup; that debt still blocks storage-quiescence/retirement. Retrying a RolledBack native attempt is a separate pending operation, not a free postseal retry. Lower Linux/Windows native contracts and original custodian survival remain those of the conditional A4/stop-order proposals, not certified here.

External boundaries explicitly identified are .NET RandomNumberGenerator.Fill, DateTime/Guid allocation, file/directory metadata/open/read/write/namespace syscalls, renderer/input, ILogger providers, and real optional hook implementations. Source lookup is not proof that these operations are joinable or that every provider is effect-free. Existing custodian must survive GM-terminal presentation loss; Client/custodian death, cold restart, reboot, new host/PID namespace, container migration and distinct-root restore still have no proved original-work-stop issuer. New G, identical JSON, hashes, timeout and PID absence prove none of that.
sections.Coverage and next bounded closure:
The finite rows and call-frontier lists below are intentionally a boundary, not an exhaustive transitive Stage leaf catalog. The bounded dice/gacha calculation/branch inventory is source-derived through real RNG/clock/FS calls; native/source-custody and partial-draw continuation remain interfaces to specify. The next coherent closure should finish one actual health or reminder helper graph (prefer QTE pending-summary consumption including real hooks and runtime serializer defaults) plus its original storage/held adapter, or complete the dice adapter contract and independent review; do not implement from this partial report. Full validation/normalizer and snapshot/restoration inventories are still required for Stage H-B02.

Root's independent F1/R01 source-history work, accepted Mortal n/action/evaluation n+1, genuine incarnation bootstrap when applicable, D4/guided/visual/D8, full target/DEP-C/I/L/H2/H3/newQTE remain unchanged/open. No target write authority, old-G rebind, new OS/security/service/key/network permission, activation or F2 is supplied. Autonomous agreed-direction design does not need another permission question, but exact engineering contracts, independent accepted review and bounded TDD/qualification remain gates.
